findings.description: On a denied request, `bucket.tokens` is updated with the refill but `bucket.updated_at` is not. The next check computes elapsed from the old timestamp and adds the same elapsed time to the already-refilled tokens, so the refill is counted twice. This over-grants tokens, and the retry_after hint is also wrong. For example, a client retrying repeatedly while denied gets tokens credited multiple times for the same interval, so the effective rate exceeds the configured limit.
findings.suggestion: Set `bucket.updated_at = now` right after refilling tokens, before the allow/deny check.
findings.title: Token bucket loses refill progress on denied requests
